subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw accept same-agent owner-scoped live orphan transcript hits as visible when session visibility permits but the combined session store has no entry?
rationale: The patch fixes a real recall gap, but it changes which private transcript snippets may surface through memory tools and overlaps broader private-recall product work, so automation should not decide that boundary alone.

options.title: Accept scoped fallback
options.body: Approve the same-agent owner-scoped fallback as intended behavior because cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits remain fail-closed.

options.title: Require gateway replay
options.body: Ask for a live gateway memory_search or memory-wiki replay with refreshed session indexing before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the behavior only through the default-off remember-across-conversations direction.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped fallback
recommendation.body: Approve the same-agent owner-scoped fallback as intended behavior because cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits remain fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active broader private-recall PR is the closest related product direction that must align with this transcript visibility choice.
